message: (`<ng-content select="[pctWidgetRetry]">`), and the tag scan never found it
$reason: `tag-swallowed-by-an-expression` with a projection point for the element: the false tag `<limit())` swallows an `<ng-content>`. It draws no element of its own and its attributes make no stop, but it is a tag of the tree like any other, so the tree's tag offsets against the scan's refuse it as they refuse a swallowed `<span>` or `<ng-template>`: the tree holds a tag at its offset, and the scan found none there. A tag reader that recorded only the kind of an `<ng-content>` left its offset out of those the scan is held to, and passed this one, while the same tag under an `*ngIf`, recorded through its wrapper, was refused; the tag scan passed it too.
